Student Summer Research Fellowship

The fellowship offers undergraduate and master's students two months of research in our labs, from July 1 to August 31.

Applications are open from November 1. The application deadline: December 15, 2026.

Applicants should have completed at least two years of study and expect to graduate in 2028 or later.
